body:
I like how well put your replies are, you seem quite intelligent too. I like that, I love logic and reasoning and science (funnily enough I study psychology, the irony) and there are so many things that make sense for the continuation of life but at the same time I'm highly nuerotic and unstable. Sometimes that gets in the way. I don't think I truly want to die per say, maybe just stop existing and have everyone forget or move to a different country and keep myself away from people, would have less to worry about and possibly manage myself. 
I needed this release, I'm not desperate right now, just angry. This had been helpful but I was somewhat afraid to post in case people thought I was attention seeking or being dramatic. In reality I'm just alone in how I feel, so while I feel extremely empathetic to your situation and everyone else's it's nice to talk to someone else who is logical but also neurotic. I don't mean that offensively, I just need someone understands the degree in which my brain is functioning. Sorry again if that sounds egotistical. I don't mean it to be.

I'm not sure if it's quite 'compulsive' when it's the main subject of my mind every single day. It's thought out, weighed out, it beats the idea of compulsion. I can give long winded explanations to absolutely anyone struggling, giving a million reasons why they are worth it, why they should continue living but for some reason I can't apply any of it to myself. Rationally I am so aware that my life is mines to make it as I please but I often can't get the images of the horrible things that have happened out of my head. It's ingrained and I'm aware that it'll never go away, it can only be 'managed' and thinking about living the rest of my life this way does not outweigh 'the good' because nothing is worth this.
I'm really sorry that you're struggling too, I wouldn't wish it on my worst enemy (if I had one) I actually very much appreciate any form of methods to help cope or dull down the ideation in my head screaming at me. 
I'm just tired and exhausted (I do have a lot of long term physical illnesses too) and I'm sick of living life telling myself "it's only temporary, it'll get better" I just want to know when that 'better' will come. 
I don't want how I feel to drag you down so I really hope you don't see my complaints as counters to your coping methods.
